short_description: Collateral-free institutional micro-credit up to ₹10 Lakhs for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
purpose: To provide funding to non-corporate small business segment (NCSBS) comprising proprietorship / partnership firms running small manufacturing units, service sector units, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, and artisans.

benefits_summary.mudra_card: Available for hassle-free working capital withdrawals

sources.document_reference: PMMY Operational Guidelines, DFS Ministry of Finance
sources.notes: Covers Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun loan tranches via scheduled commercial banks, RRBs, SFBs, and MFIs.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an Indian citizen of at least 18 years of age.
The loan must be utilized for a non-farm income-generating micro-business activity.
Applicant must not have a previous default record with any banking or financial institution.

documents.document_name: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License)

documents.description: Recent utility bill / Aadhaar card / Voter ID

documents.document_name: Quotation of Machinery / Items to be Purchased
documents.description: Supplier quotation for capital items or raw materials to be acquired
Udyam registration certificate or municipal trade license if already in operation
